annotations.reason_zh: 摘要明确论文任务为partial multi-label learning，需为实例处理多个候选/真标记，属于多标记学习。

annotations.exact_quote: candidate label sets containing both partial ground-truth labels and noisy labels

annotations.exact_quote: instances are associated with candidate label sets containing both partial ground-truth labels and noisy labels

annotations.exact_quote: label correlations can effectively enhance classifier robustness, yet label correlations extracted directly from noisy label information are inherently biased and imprecise.
